stage: Host oracle-evidence scale screen, not deployment or production retrieval
admission: At each launch require MemAvailable >= candidate file bytes + 3 GiB per-process allocation/JVM reserve + 2 GiB host reserve; one resident model/context per process. No GPU available in sandbox. No emulator inference concurrently.
decoder: Greedy generateChat for every candidate; no claims grammar, no seed search; pinned Qwen3 non-thinking template handling retained
architecture: Deterministic semicolon obligation plan, dated subject-specific sources, ranked per-obligation reading order, one labeled answer slot per obligation. Existing citation/completeness/number/temporal/lexical claim checks retained; full support/completeness judged separately by builder source review.
selection: Rank fully source-supported, obligation-complete, useful drafts; report screened candidates separately. Prefer no unsupported candidate publications and smaller assets on quality ties. Do not deploy on raw host score; require measured profile and real emulator subset. Negative results retain precise integration/architecture follow-up.
timing: Per-process CPU host under up to two six-thread jobs, including text-output capture; separate from Android and previous thread/backend results. Token count and native sample maxima recorded. No phone speed claim.
